As we navigate through the ups and downs of life, let go of that notion that our struggles hold the power to halt the world's progress. Instead, focus on what you can control-- your own actions, mindset, and choices. Even in the face of adversity, we can choose to keep moving forward, persisting with unwavering determination.

About Me

Who's behind Chamber of Thoughts?

I am a licensed professional teacher, a financial consultant, a motivational blogger, and an influencer. I majored English during my undergraduate studies and have started taking up master’s degree in teaching English language.

Currently, I am teaching in a public high school, pursuing my passion of simply becoming a person of great influence to the future of this world -the learners. I teach English and Theater Arts which are both taking up a great space in my heart.
